verdict.reason: All written main and SI experimental branches can be represented by an original route, but equipment/service interfaces, quantitative validation, data provenance, software details and safe execution boundaries remain to be completed.

coverage.unit: SI Note 4, pp6–7: spatial mapping and corrections
SI Note 5, pp7–9: raster/random/Hadamard, compressed sensing, denoiser

coverage.unit: Description of Additional Supplementary Files, 1 page

findings.finding: The 10 Hz demonstration uses the analog detector and a 16×16 reconstruction. It is not the photon-sparse result or a 64×64 video result.
findings.source: Main pp4–5, Fig. 3; SI Note 3, pp5–6
findings.route_requirement: Separate bright/analog video, photon-counting full sampling, and photon-counting compressive branches.

findings.finding: 0.5 photons/pulse is a mean incident illumination level, accumulated over many pulses; 25% compressive imaging with the denoiser is demonstrated down to 1 photon/pulse.
findings.route_requirement: Store incident mean photons/pulse, pulse rate, display duration, physical mask count, detected counts, and elapsed frame time as distinct fields.

findings.finding: Reconstructed grids of 16×16 and 64×64 do not establish equal numbers of independently resolved spatial elements. The main text reports achieved resolution about 91 μm.
findings.route_requirement: Separate numerical pixel grid, optical resolution, field of view, and pattern fidelity; do not claim superresolution.

findings.finding: Signed Hadamard coefficients are formed using successive complementary intensity masks. N coefficients are not N physical exposures.
findings.route_requirement: Declare mask and coefficient counting convention. For unnormalized ±1 Hadamard matrices use H transpose divided by N, rather than an unscaled transpose.

findings.finding: Written main/SI do not report independent experimental-repeat counts, confidence intervals, or a quantitative reconstruction-error/generalization study.
findings.source: Main Figs. 2–5; SI Figs. 3–6 and Notes 4–7
findings.route_requirement: Label all prospective repeats, quantitative acceptance thresholds, blinded targets, and statistical analysis as newly authored design.

findings.finding: Data and study reconstruction code are on request. SI references earlier synchronization and MIR generation/calibration work and adapted l1-MAGIC and DRUNet/DPIR implementations.
findings.source: Main p7 Data/Code availability; SI Notes 2,5 and references 3–5,15–17
findings.route_requirement: Do not imply public study data, exact runnable code, reproducible weights/settings, or completed source-level numerical replication.

findings.finding: The silicon wafer transmission study is part of the written supplement and is not a biological experiment or actual semiconductor defect-detection validation.
findings.route_requirement: Retain the material-imaging branch for whole-paper coverage; use qualified, externally fabricated sealed targets, and do not export the laser-etching recipe.

findings.finding: The simple intensity-product observation law is an approximation; finite crystal angular acceptance, propagation, illumination profile and spectral-temporal overlap matter.
findings.route_requirement: Treat source equations as physical interpretation, not a validated executable hardware model; require measured calibration and validity bounds.

findings.finding: The denoiser comparisons are visual examples without supplied training/adaptation settings or a held-out validation protocol. Gaussian denoising is applied despite photon-counting statistics discussed as Poissonian.
findings.source: Main Fig. 5, p6; SI Note 5, p9 and Note 6
findings.route_requirement: Retain pre-denoising outputs and raw observations; evaluate task fidelity against independently measured ground truth, not image smoothness alone.

findings.finding: Supplementary movies were fully decoded without errors and sampled visually, not validated frame-by-frame. Movie 1 contains full-set 16×16 input/pump/corrected-pump comparisons, not full-set SFG outputs. Movie 2 displays 16×16 at 10 Hz and 32×32 at 2.5 Hz, with the right side sped up 4× for playback.
findings.source: Media-description PDF and Movie 1/2 contact sheets; ffprobe/ffmpeg metadata and decode audit
findings.route_requirement: Include the 32×32 video branch. Separate measured acquisition/reconstruction rate from media playback rate. Do not claim all-frame quantitative fidelity or full-set SFG mapping from these movies.

findings.finding: Raster/random/Hadamard comparisons use the same incident illumination power, but the paper does not establish universal multiplex advantage or equal total dose/time for every comparison. Detector-noise and shot-noise regimes must be distinguished.
findings.source: Main p4; SI Note 5 and Fig. 4
findings.route_requirement: Report the comparison budget explicitly and avoid extrapolating detector-noise-limited advantage into every photon-counting condition.

controls_reported: Gaussian illumination profile correction and uncorrected/corrected images
Numerical and experimental letter reconstructions compared

derived_checks.expression: 2 × 256 × 200 microseconds = 0.1024 seconds, about 9.77 frames/s before additional overhead
derived_checks.status: Derived audit consistency check, not a new experiment

derived_checks.description: Main Fig. 4 incident photon budget per displayed pattern at endpoints
derived_checks.expression: 14.6 million pulses/s × 100 photons/pulse × 0.005 s = 14.6 million × 0.5 × 1 s = 7.3 million incident photons
derived_checks.status: Derived before object/mask, conversion, filtering and detector losses; not total detected photons or per-image count

required_closed_boundaries: Qualified service fabricates and certifies etched-silicon and transmission targets
Qualified optical service performs source construction, alignment, nonlinear conversion tuning, detector substitution, and safety certification
Robot handles only approved fixtures and enclosed hardware interfaces; invalid interlocks abort
No exposed laser alignment or etching recipe exported
proposed_original_validation: Prespecified independent repeat sessions and acquisition-order randomization
Blank/blocked/background and flat-field controls with drift tracking
Observed DMD-pattern and count-stream registration, missing-event checks and physical-exposure counts
Measured resolution and field-of-view test independent of reconstructed grid size
Ground-truth fidelity scoring before and after denoising on independent nonbiological targets
Matched-time and matched-incident-dose comparison reported separately
Raw counts, timings, masks, calibration provenance and software/model hashes retained

findings.finding: Qualified laser service is an authored boundary, while source only reports laser etching; split source and authored claims.
Photon detector switching can overlap dynamic analog imaging under current dependency graph; require R11 after R10 or enforce exclusive station lease.
SI encoding-comparison detector and exposure are not clearly specified; inherited photon-counting mode must be explicitly authored or treated as unresolved.
Freeze repeat count, acquisition order and stopping rule before first acquisition; late R20 guard alone does not establish prospective preregistration.

findings.target: route.json R07/R08 and forthcoming station requirements
findings.finding: Spatial pump and SFG maps require diagnostic imaging capability beyond a bucket detector; specify qualified service/sensor receipt and separate full pump vs representative SFG evidence.
Removed incorrect before-attenuation wording; incident occupancy already incorporates defining attenuation.
Added branch-compatible detector/calibration requalification guard after configuration changes.
